note: spring5-xml: WebConfig extends the WebMvcConfigurerAdapter Spring 6 removed → implements WebMvcConfigurer (its methods are defaults); the override / type errors in WebConfig wait (deferred) — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|WebMvcConfigurerAdapter` (f3aceea80f)
response:
<analysis>WebMvcConfigurerAdapter was deprecated in Spring 5.0 and removed in Spring Framework 6; WebMvcConfigurer has default methods for everything the adapter implemented. The script imports WebMvcConfigurer instead of the adapter and turns `extends WebMvcConfigurerAdapter` into `implements WebMvcConfigurer` (merged into an existing implements clause); the @Override methods then override the interface defaults.</analysis>
<script>
import re

OLD_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurerAdapter;"
NEW_IMPORT = "import org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer;"

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = text
        if NEW_IMPORT in new:
            new = new.replace(OLD_IMPORT + "\n", "")
        else:
            new = new.replace(OLD_IMPORT, NEW_IMPORT)
        new = re.sub(r"\bextends\s+WebMvcConfigurerAdapter\s+implements\s+", "implements WebMvcConfigurer, ", new)
        new = re.sub(r"\bextends\s+WebMvcConfigurerAdapter\b", "implements WebMvcConfigurer", new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: WebMvcConfigurerAdapter -> implements WebMvcConfigurer")
        else:
            p.log(f"{path}: no WebMvcConfigurerAdapter left")
</script>
